User: I think price and I think also portion size. How I judge it is just really measuring the price to the portion size of what I'm getting. So if I'm getting more and I'm getting a deal for more portion, then that's usually a deal for me.
Agent: So, for you, good value in fast food comes down to price and portion size, and you judge it by the ratio of what you pay to the amount of food you receive.
